ModMetaData.name: Barbslinger Art Override
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description: Replaces sarg.alphaanimals' AA_Barbslinger art (primary look only - the AA_BarbSlinger2/3/4 alternate looks and the dessicated-corpse texture stay on donor art) with custom generated Pyrelands-themed art (pyrelands_barbslinger_v2). LABEL/ART ONLY - no defName touched, no Defs, no Patches, loose Textures/ only, same relative path (Things/Pawn/Animal/AA_BarbSlinger/AA_BarbSlinger_<facing>) the donor uses so this mod's later load order wins the same-path resolution.
